finding.summary: Root-level files contribute to the global record count but are absent from the directory-node graph and from direct-record counts; no explicit root node is produced.

evidence.observation: For each path the prefix loop skips insertion when the prefix reaches the leaf. A root-level file has one component, so it contributes no directory prefix.
Direct-record counts are incremented only when the path has more than one component, excluding root-level files.
Output nodes are built only from the collected directory set; the global record total still uses the full input path count.
The fixture includes README.md at the root, but assertions cover aggregate counts and selected non-root nodes; they do not assert a root node or root-level direct-record attribution.

finding.scope: Static source and fixture review; no test was run for this audit.

basis.observation: Each input path visits successive prefixes and repeatedly joins component prefixes.
Each directory node scans prefixes and joins them while resolving aliases.

complexity.method: Static component-count estimate from repeated prefix construction; no scale measurement was performed.
boundaries: Does not include string-byte lengths, hashing, sorting of nodes or children, output serialization, or filesystem and process costs.
The estimate does not establish a measured bottleneck, scaling threshold, or performance regression.

historicalPreviewRecord.interpretation: Previously recorded source evidence only; not rerun or used as a current scale profile in this audit.

provenanceBoundary.observation: The CLI receives tree-list bytes and policy as separate inputs. The caller is responsible for independently binding those bytes to the declared commit/tree and for authenticating readback; this audit does not confirm that linkage.
